shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and Ethereum have rebounded above key price levels today, signaling improved risk sentiment.
Despite the recent price bounce, US spot Bitcoin ETFs continue to experience outflows, indicating ongoing institutional caution.
Investors await today's US Non-Farm Payrolls report, which could influence Federal Reserve policy and crypto markets.
Progress in US-Iran talks is contributing to a broader improvement in risk sentiment across financial markets.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains in the "Fear" zone, suggesting overall investor apprehension despite recent gains.
